primary_thesis: SCRIPTED FIXTURE. Value depends on GPU-hour pricing holding up as the fleet ages; the pricing survey (EV-005) and the 2024 useful-life extension (EV-009) suggest reported earnings overstate sustainable cash generation.
strongest_opposing_thesis: Contracted power of 2.5 GW against 0.9 GW energised (EV-013) and management's $3.00 contracted pricing (EV-003) could support rapid growth if energisation accelerates.
catalysts: Q3 energised MW versus the 1.6 GW dark backlog
Repricing of the next large contract renewal
key_risks: The majority of analysts agree pricing decay is underappreciated.
